verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage's docs state that cases, alerts and risks can be reviewed and remediated through the API for use in your own case management system. The API covers case decisions, case audit trails, case exports, external-identifier customer lookup, and webhooks with idempotency keys, and the published OpenAPI schema documents case and audit resources. missing for 10: explicit documentation of case/decision-change webhook event types (only WORKFLOW_COMPLETED is shown), detailed guidance on two-way decision write-back, independent or hands-on corroboration of a sync integration.
